relations.rationale: The pottery class occurring on Tuesday evenings makes it plausible Ben arrives late and wet from rain, but this is only weak circumstantial support at best.
The existence of a pottery class has no bearing on relative ages of attendees.
The class schedule has no bearing on relative ages of Ben and Noor.
The class existing supports the plausibility of Fay sketching glaze ideas before it begins, since it establishes the class as a recurring event she could prepare for.
A weekly pottery class over a term would plausibly produce shelves of finished pieces awaiting firing, supporting that claim.
Alma being treasurer has no bearing on who took photographs.
Being treasurer is a financial role unrelated to owning carving tools.
Being treasurer does not imply willingness to lend tools.
Alma's role as treasurer has no bearing on whether pieces differ from each other.
Noor arriving first directly supports her being the one to set out supplies before others arrive.
Noor arriving first is consistent with Ben arriving late, but doesn't strongly imply it.
Noor's arrival order has no bearing on Fay's seating preference.
Noor arriving first is unrelated to Alma's willingness to lend tools.
Arrival order has no bearing on height.
Noor's arrival time has no bearing on group laughter during break.
Noor setting out materials before anyone arrives is consistent with Ben arriving late, but doesn't establish it.
Noor's setup routine has no bearing on Alma's tool-lending habits.
Noor's setup routine before class is unrelated to the group's tea-sharing during break.
Noor's setup routine is unrelated to laughter during break.
Ben tending to arrive late supports the claim that he's still shaking off rain most weeks, as latecomers exposed to rain would show these signs.
